question: Two compounds A and B form a solid dispersion, the boiling temperature of pure A being lower than that of pure compound B. Indicate which of the following statements is correct:

options.opa: Below the eutectic temperature the system is formed by micro crystals of A dissolved in liquid B.
options.opb: Below the eutectic temperature the system is formed by micro crystals of B dissolved in liquid A.
options.opc: Below the eutectic temperature the system will consist of a mixture of A and B, both in the solid state.
options.opd: When cooling a solution of B in A, in which A is the solvent, crystals of B will appear.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Pure A has a lower boiling temperature than pure B -> A is the solute in the solid dispersion -> 80% CHAIN: Below the eutectic temperature, micro crystals of A are dissolved in liquid B -> 70% CHAIN: When cooling a solution of B in A, crystals of B will appear -> 80%
analysis: In a solid dispersion, the compound with the lower boiling temperature (A in this case) will form micro crystals dissolved in the compound with the higher boiling temperature (B). This means that below the eutectic temperature, the system is formed by micro crystals of A dissolved in liquid B.
